title: Geology, contact growth and ancient assembly asset bank
status: authoring-library candidates; no live-runtime or whole-asset acceptance claim
fictionDevelopmentAgreement: ART EXTRAPOLATION: reusable geological cuts, host-contact tissue and dormant ceramic machine interfaces. No new species, maker, ancient civilization, history, gameplay promise or canon is asserted.

visibleZones.bill: Bare stratified mineral, fractured along deliberately stepped cleavages; untiled dry rough stone, no hull grid, plastic sheen or randomized spike decoration. Quarried parent and wedge share the identical mating plane; collars preserve bores.
Opaque mineral/ice crystal facets with satin dielectric response, physical ridges and split gaps. No transparent toy glass, emissive crystal or scientific claim.

Bare dry calcified organic tissue, pale outer ridges over dark channels. Branches taper continuously and root into host-contact feet; fan and lung folds have thickness. No lacquer, machinery panel tile, floating cyst or invented organism identity.
Flattened calcified bases transmit tissue loads to adjacent host surfaces; exposed stump channels receive distinct dark interior. Pads and end sockets identify actual mounting/contact surfaces.

visibleZones.zone: ancient ceramic shell and structural sections
visibleZones.bill: Sintered ceramic segments with broad dry faces, stepped laps, restrained chamfers and recessed joints. Load enters feet, tenons or rebates; folded/channeled sections retain deliberate service openings. No human lacquer, checker texture or arbitrary decorative rune.

visibleZones.zone: ancient recessed substrate and mineral inserts
visibleZones.bill: Dark bare mineral substrate and sparse warm mineral inserts set into ceramic housings, non-emissive and mechanically supported. No unexplained lights, floating trim or modern painted hazard marks.

shapeGrammar: Assemblies derive from fracture, cleavage, load paths, growth contact anatomy, ceramic channel sections and interlocking stepped joints. Tube-derived tissue is tapered and branched with continuous transported frames; ring apertures remain open; slab shells gain rebated edges and seated supports.
